metadata.title: KFC Popcorn bowl made with Maggi
metadata.description:
#paidpartnership #advertisement 

The all-new KFC Popcorn Bowl Made With Maggi combines the timeless taste of everyone's favourite Maggi noodles 🍜 with @KFCOfficial's crisp & juicy Chicken Popcorn🍗 to create an amazing combination of taste & nostalgia 👌🏻💯

So give this bowl of happiness a try & let us know what you thought? 

#Maggi #KFCIndia #Innovation #Flavour #Nostalgia #FoodReview #Collaboration
